minutes.headline: Sewer Commission weighs creating new hookup/bedroom fees for accessory dwelling units.
minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Sewer Commission approved prior minutes and FY25 year-end billing adjustments, reviewed ongoing Dana/D Street pump and manhole repair work, and discussed billing/delinquency status. Much of the meeting concerned whether and how to charge new fees for accessory dwelling units and additional bedrooms, comparing neighboring towns, with a decision to draft an initial letter to the town board rather than set a fee immediately; the commission also questioned the cost of annual system mapping in its engineering contract and discussed overall system capacity.

what_happened.line: The commission decided to draft a letter to the town board raising a new hookup/bedroom fee for accessory dwelling units, without setting a fee amount.
Commissioners voted to accept FY25 year-end billing adjustments, with the amount as heard varying between readings in the recording.
A commissioner questioned why the engineering contract requires full system mapping every year rather than less often, and asked staff to check whether that is required by statute.
The business manager said the sewer delinquency rate appears lower than previously stated, though it is too early to assess the new fiscal year's collections.

why_it_matters: A new ADU hookup or per-bedroom sewer fee would affect anyone adding an accessory dwelling unit or extra bedroom, though no rate has been proposed yet.
The FY25 adjustment vote and delinquency discussion touch how sewer bills are calculated and collected, which flows into the rates the district charges.
The question about the engineering contract's annual mapping requirement could affect what the sewer system spends on outside engineering services, a cost eventually built into rates.
